knows.instructionsPlaceholder: Misali: Ka amsa da Hausa. Ka taƙaita. Ina da gidan burodi.
you.line: Ana aika umarnoninka da abin da aka lura tare da kowace ɗawainiya zuwa ƙwaƙwalwar da ke amsawa.
you.none: Babu komai game da kai tukuna. Abin da ka rubuta a nan ana karanta shi a farkon kowace ɗawainiya.

you.cut.one: Ba a karanta layi mafi tsufa yanzu. Don a karanta shi, mai da shi umarni.
you.cut.other: Ba a karanta layuka {count} mafi tsufa yanzu. Don a karanta ɗaya, mai da shi umarni.

you.nameText: Sunan da ake kiranka da shi. Ba a taɓa aika shi zuwa kowace ƙwaƙwalwa.
you.empty: Me ya kamata a riƙa tunawa koyaushe? Aikinka, harsunanka, yadda kake son amsoshi.
you.search: Nemo cikin abin da aka lura
you.project: Waɗannan suna tafiya tare da naka, a ɗawainiyoyinsa kaɗai.
